violations.issue_explanation: Form control <input> lacks a programmatic label (<label for='...'>, wrapping <label>, or aria-label). violations.suggested_fix: <label for="cardholder-name">Descriptive Label</label> or add aria-label="Descriptive Label" to the <input> element.
